paper_title: Constraints on bosonic dark matter from ultralow-field nuclear magnetic resonance
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1 (ALP wind-nucleon linear coupling, as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 3)
notes: CASPEr-ZULF sideband search (Garcon et al. 2019, arXiv:1902.04644). New measured 90% CL exclusion on the ALP wind nucleon coupling g_aNN over masses 1.8e-16 to 7.85e-14 eV (45 mHz - 19 Hz). No numerical table is given; data points are reconstructed from Fig. 3 axis ranges and the stated 1/omega modulation-index sensitivity scaling, so coupling values are approximate (order-of-magnitude reliable, shape reliable; sharp sensitivity-loss spikes at 0.21, 1.69, 2.16 Hz not modeled). Paper assumes equal proton/neutron coupling -> AxionNeutron chosen per generic-nucleon rule. Paper also sets limits on quadratic wind coupling g_quad and dark-photon gdEDM/gdMDM couplings (not extracted here), plus a Phase II projection (~1e5 better) shown as dashed lines only. rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.7, 41)) | Vision: Traced the red CASPEr-ZULF exclusion region lower boundary from Fig. 3 (ALP wind-nucleon linear coupling, thermally polarized sample, 850 x 30s acquisitions, 90% CL). Mass range confirmed by text: 1.86e-16 to ~7.85e-14 eV (plot right edge at ~4.1e-14 eV / 10 Hz). Boundary rises roughly linearly (slope ~1) on log-log plot from g_aNN ~5e-5 GeV^-1 at 1.86e-16 eV to ~1e-2 GeV^-1 at the right edge. Sharp sensitivity-loss spikes included at Compton frequencies 0.21, 1.69, 2.16 Hz (masses ~8.7e-16, 7.0e-15, 8.9e-15 eV) as described in the text. Coupling is to nucleons (g_aNN); per protocol, generic nucleon coupling mapped to AxionNeutron. Note y-axis units are GeV^-1, not dimensionless.
